audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping only; paired topic integration is development-only and RNA-conditioned ATAC is ineligible

mira_local.corpus: No admitted upstream checkpoint; declared outer-training count matrices only

interpretation: MIRA 2.1.1 has no upstream pretraining contamination when fit locally and its expression topic model exposes an amortized frozen RNA query path. Its joint representation is only a horizontal concatenation of independently inferred RNA and ATAC topic embeddings for exactly shared cells. Different aliquots cannot be joined, and an RNA-only query cannot obtain the ATAC topics. Within-modality decoder imputation is not cross-modal prediction. Execution and champion eligibility are additionally blocked because the release repository and PyPI metadata declare BSD3 but provide no complete license text or license file.
